definitions.explanation: Clothes and other items that need to be washed, or that have been washed and need to be dried.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す。
examples.english: To hang the laundry out to dry.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{乾|かわ}いた。
{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}りそうだから、{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{取|と}り{込|こ}まなきゃ。
examples.english: It looks like it might rain, so I need to bring in the laundry.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す: to hang laundry
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{取|と}り{込|こ}む: to bring in laundry
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの}をたたむ: to fold laundry

USAGE NOTE:
Refers to clothes in any stage of the laundry process - waiting to be washed, currently washing, or drying. In Japan, hanging laundry outside to dry is common.

RELATED:
- {洗濯|せんたく}: laundry (action), washing
- {物干|ものほ}し: drying rack/line
